name: Darth Momin's superweapon
description: Sometime prior to the Clone Wars, Sith Lord Darth Momin used a superweapon to destroy a city. Momin intended to pour the Force into its engine and freeze the terrified expressions of its victims forever. However, when Momin attempted this, the Jedi intervened and his plan failed, destroying his physical body. Momin later came to see the project as a failure.
